{{Top|leg}}
An '''impoundment-fastener''' was a heavy-duty, molecularly-activated lock that was designed to secure large, bulky items. The fastener was activated by a [[molecularly coded key]] which 'read' the lock. A molecular chain was formed between the key and the lock, and was broken as the key was removed, activating the lock. The lock could be opened only when the the key was reinserted, reuniting the bisected halves of the molecular chain.<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> They were sold at [[Rordan's Spaceship Parts and More]] in [[Verena City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]].<ref name="DS">{{WEGCite|story=Den of Spies|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
